packageRules.description: Bun follows the Bun of the pinned Windmill image (WR-3, ADR 0001); it moves only with the semantics pin.
The jsonb test image follows the oracle's PostgreSQL major; only digest and patch updates within 16.
The Windmill oracle image is the semantics pin (v1.767.0); it is never bumped by Renovate.
The oracle workflow's Node runs the pinned windmill-cli@1.767.0 (OR-8); its major moves only with the oracle pin.
The native runtime's embedded client is the version Windmill v1.767.0 embeds (WR-40: OpenAPI.VERSION 1.326.0); it moves only with the semantics pin.
